title: The Inspector Modal exposes the local PGlite database and sync remote channel states (inbox, outbox, dead letter) for debugging
content:
The Inspector Modal is a Connect development tool with two tabs: Database (explore local PGlite tables with schema tree, pagination, sorting, and export/import) and Remotes (view sync remotes and their channel states). Each remote has Inbox (received operations), Outbox (pending send), and Dead Letter (failed sync with error info). Operations have statuses: Pending, Applied, or Error. The Inspector is generally available to every Connect user — there is no feature flag. To open it, click the **Settings** (gear) button in the Connect sidebar footer, select the **About** tab, then click **Open Inspector**.

_Corrected 2026-08-13 against Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: Generally available (no feature flag): Connect sidebar footer > Settings > About > Open Inspector. Shows DB tables, remote sync channel states, and DB export/import.
